conditions: An OptionalExpression production in §13.3.9.1 is evaluated and evaluation plus GetValue of its base completes with undefined or null.
limitations: The operation can propagate an abrupt completion while evaluating or retrieving the base. Other falsy values do not meet the defined criterion.

triggers: Controlling edition correction, applicability change, or material counterexample.

statement: ECMAScript 2024 optional-chain evaluation returns undefined before evaluating the chain when the retrieved base value is undefined or null.
